# Design tokens

> Generated by `npm run build` from `design-tokens.tokens.json`. Do not edit by hand.

403 CSS custom properties from 132 tokens: **16 colour roles**, **90 primitive colours**, 8 spacing steps, 15 text styles, 3 shadows.

## The one rule: roles in, primitives out

The colour model has two tiers, and only one of them is for product code.

```
  component  ->  --ds-color-primary            semantic role     USE THIS
                     |
                     +-> --ds-color-primitive-key-primary   foundation    not for components
```

| Tier | Prefix | Meaning | Allowed in components |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Semantic roles | `--ds-color-*` | Intent: primary, error, on-primary-container. Stable across themes. | **Yes** |
| Primitives | `--ds-color-primitive-*` | Raw palette steps and key colours. The source of truth the roles point at. | **No** |

A role is emitted as a `var()` reference to its primitive, so re-pointing one primitive re-themes everything downstream. If a component reads a primitive directly, a future dark theme or rebrand has to be chased through the codebase.

### Applying a text style

```css
:root { --my-font-family: "DM Sans"; }
.prose { font: var(--ds-typography-display-large-font); }
```

### Token property to CSS property mapping

| Figma property | CSS property | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fontFamily` | `font-family` |  |
| `fontSize` | `font-size` |  |
| `fontWeight` | `font-weight` |  |
| `fontStyle` | `font-style` |  |
| `fontStretch` | `font-stretch` | Only meaningful for variable fonts. |
| `letterSpacing` | `letter-spacing` |  |
| `lineHeight` | `line-height` |  |
| `textDecoration` | `text-decoration` |  |
| `textCase` | `text-transform` | Figma text case mapped to `text-transform`. |
| `paragraphIndent` | `text-indent` | Applied to the first line of a paragraph. |
| `paragraphSpacing` | `margin` | Figma paragraph spacing has no direct CSS equivalent; mapped to `margin`. |

## Findings from the last build

5 findings.

| | Level | Token | Finding |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ! | WARNING | `--ds-spacing-large` | The spacing scale is not in ascending order: --ds-spacing-large is 18 but --ds-spacing-extra-large, listed before it, is 24. |
| i | NOTE | `colour roles` | No surface, background or outline roles exist. Components will have to reach for a primitive for page backgrounds and borders; consider adding `background`, `surface`, `outline` roles to the token set. |
| i | NOTE | `primitive colour collection.key colour group` | 5 of 6 values in Key colours have no role pointing at them: secondary key colour, tertiary key colour, neutral key colour, neutral variant key colour, error key colour. |
| i | NOTE | `primitive colour collection.neutral colour palette` | No colour role references Neutral palette (14 steps). It is a foundation with no semantic entry point yet. |
| i | NOTE | `primitive colour collection.neutral variant colour palette` | No colour role references Neutral variant palette (14 steps). It is a foundation with no semantic entry point yet. |
